theme_central: The first five verses are the very first revelation of the Qur'an — "Read, in the name of your Lord who created" — followed by a warning against whoever prevents a servant from praying.
sources_note: Status of verses 1-5 as the first historical revelation extremely well established and undisputed; traditional identification of the opponent (Abu Jahl preventing the Prophet from praying) widely taught.

branches.title: The first revelation
branches.resume: "Read, in the name of your Lord who created" — man created from a clinging clot, taught by the pen.

children.t: First revelation: "Read", man's creation, teaching by the pen

branches.title: Rebellion in ease
branches.resume: Man becomes rebellious as soon as he sees himself self-sufficient; the return is to Allah.

children.t: Man's rebellion in ease, inevitable return to Allah

branches.title: The one who prevents prayer
branches.resume: Warning against whoever prevents a servant from praying, while Allah sees everything.

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Threat to seize the opponent by his lying forelock; final command to prostrate and draw near.

children.t: Threat against the opponent, final call to prostration
